## Checks

- [ ] `ruff check src tests tools`, `pytest` and `python tools/check_repo.py` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change and run without hardware
- [ ] No limit, safe state, lock or role is loosened
- [ ] No private addresses, names, paths, tokens or keys
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (under Unreleased) are updated where users will notice the change
